scope: One sequential measurement each on local macOS14 arm64; includes Python startup/import, decode, auto recipe, both full-resolution PNG encodes and temporary PNG/JSON writes. Excludes web rendering, NPZ serialization and user interaction. Synthetic uniform 12MP JPEG is not a textured real-photo timing sample.
memory_semantics: macOS /usr/bin/time -l reported maximum resident set size; not a sampled summed Python+native-engine process-tree peak. No 40MP throughput or memory guarantee.
